headline: Aria Resorts India submits SEBI Reg 31(4) takeover disclosure for Asian Hotels (West)
sum: Aria Resorts India Private Ltd has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), signalling a material acquisition or voting interest change in Asian Hotels (West) Limited, a hospitality entity.
detail: Aria Resorts India Private Ltd submitted to NSE a copy of its Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is mandatory when a party acquires or has acquired, during the preceding 6 months, shares or voting rights such that its shareholding reaches or crosses a prescribed threshold (typically 25%, 35%, 50%, or 75%). The filing indicates a material event in Asian Hotels (West) Limited's cap table. No acquisition price, share count, or percentage stake has been disclosed in the available excerpt.
